findings: `subtract` in target/src/calc/__init__.py is implemented as `return 2` instead of `return a - b`. The plan requires `a - b`. This is a hardcoded value that only passes the single test case `subtract(3, 1) == 2`, and it is wrong for every other input.

The test file target/tests/test_subtract.py has only one assertion, `subtract(3, 1) == 2`. That is too weak to catch the hardcoded implementation. It needs more cases, such as negative results, zero and negative inputs, to actually check subtraction.
